title: Cryptids, campfires and candy. Dillon State Park's October adventure begins
excerpt: Dillon State Park is hosting a month of Halloween events including a Spooktacular and cryptid programs.
content:
Oct. 3, 2026, 5:11 a.m. ET

Dillon State Park will offer a month of nature programs, family activities and Halloween-themed events in Muskingum County, highlighted by the park's annual Halloween Spooktacular and a series of cryptid, science and outdoor recreation programs.

According to a community announcement, the schedule includes activities ranging from archery and turtle education programs to scavenger hunts, hayrides, a costume contest and trick-or-treating throughout the campground.

The park also is partnering with the Muskingum County Library on several programs, including a cryptozoology presentation and a family adventure book club event.

The naturalist programs begin Oct. 9 with an introductory archery lesson for ages 8 and older at the park range. Registration is required through michael.durst@dnr.ohio.

Additional early-month programs include a turtle talk at the nature center and a family adventure book club activity combining reading with flower pounding and leaf rubbing.

A cryptozoology presentation, Captivating Cryptids: Creatures of Legend and Reality, is scheduled from 5:30 to 7 p.m. Oct. 14 at the John McIntire Library. The presentation will examine the science, history and regional case studies associated with cryptozoology.

Registration for the book club and the cryptozoology presentation is available through muskingumlibrary.libnet.info/events.

Halloween Spooktacular returns to Dillon State Park

The park's Halloween Spooktacular is scheduled for Oct. 23-24, with community partners, vendors and food trucks expected onsite from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Oct. 24, according to the announcement.

Activities beginning Oct. 23 include a scavenger hunt, a 50/50 raffle benefiting the Friends of Dillon State Park, an eco-friendly scarecrow workshop, a pumpkin sale, a bean soup and cornbread feast and a Halloween trivia competition.

The larger slate of events continues Oct. 24 with breakfast hosted by the Friends of Dillon State Park, games, vendor displays, hands-on science activities, pumpkin painting and the annual pumpkin roll competition.

Hayrides are scheduled from noon to 3 p.m., followed by a costume contest featuring age divisions and a pet category. Trick-or-treating throughout the campground is scheduled from 4 to 5:30 p.m.

A campground road closure affecting all vehicle traffic is planned from 3:45 to 5:45 p.m. during trick-or-treat activities.

Cryptids, science programs and campground contests planned

Additional Halloween-themed programming includes The Park After Dark: Cryptid Crawl, a guided walk introducing participants to creatures such as Bigfoot and Mothman. Organizers note the event is designed for walking and may include participants in creature costumes that could be frightening for younger children.

Campers also can participate in a decorated campsite judging contest, with prizes awarded to the top three entries.

Later in the month, the park will host Mischief Night: Halloween Candy Chemistry from 5:30 to 6 p.m. Oct. 30, followed by a nighttime hike and seasonal science demonstration from 6:30 to 7:30 p.m.

For information about programs or group opportunities, participants may contact Park Naturalist Michael Durst at michael.durst@dnr.ohio.gov or 740-915-1896.
